description: Stability criteria for the composition sensitivity sweep. A simulation run is considered 'stable' (i.e. non-degenerate, suitable for AMM-effect estimation) iff ALL listed criteria are satisfied. This is NOT a calibration target -- it is the filter that excludes pathological agent configurations from the main analysis.

criteria.name: spread_finite
criteria.description: Average quoted spread is finite and below 50 bps (real EUR/USD spot rarely exceeds this even under stress).

criteria.name: depth_nontrivial
criteria.description: Average displayed CLOB depth is non-trivial. Below 50 base units the market has effectively no orderbook.

criteria.name: volatility_bounded
criteria.description: Realized volatility is bounded. Above 100x baseline indicates explosive dynamics.

criteria.name: systemic_liquidity_alive
criteria.description: Systemic liquidity stays above 0.3 in calm state -- below this means a degenerate liquidity index.

criteria.name: trades_executed
criteria.description: At least a minimum number of trades execute. Less means no meaningful market activity.
